stemMarkdown: The price of an article is increased by 17% and the new price is then decreased by 36%. Find the net percentage change in the price. (Enter a negative value for a net decrease.)
solutionMarkdown: Start from 100. After the increase: $100 \times (1 + 17/100) = 117.00$. After the decrease: $117.00 \times (1 - 36/100) = 74.88$. Net change $= -25.12\%$.
